Consistent 2-3 decision points per lesson (not overcomplicated with 16 choices)
Pierre puppet provides consistent character throughout all lessons
Clear timing structure: 8min opening, 27min main, 10min closing
Materials lists are simple and accessible to substitute teachers
Visual supports are clearly described for non-French speaking subs
Troubleshooting sections provide immediate solutions for common issues
Vocabulary limited to 3 key words per lesson - manageable and focused
weaknesses: Some lessons (16-20) introduce additional complexity that might overwhelm Grade 1s
Decision points could be more specific about timing/when to make choices

strengths: Clear scaffolding from greetings (Lesson 1) to celebration (Lesson 20)
Vocabulary spirals beautifully - greetings return in every lesson
Physical progression: gestures → simple words → combinations → presentation
Pierre puppet creates continuity and familiarity across all lessons
Colors (Lesson 3) reinforced in art (Lesson 17) and throughout
Body parts (Lesson 7) used in actions (Lesson 10) and music (Lesson 19)
Emotional vocabulary (Lesson 12) connects to preferences (Lesson 9)
Assessment builds from observation to simple presentations
weaknesses: Lessons 15-20 feel like extensions rather than core progression

strengths: Decision points genuinely support teacher thinking and adaptation
Acknowledges unpredictability: 'How comfortable are students with new sounds?'
Flexible approaches: 'Use approach that best matches student learning styles'
Inclusive considerations for diverse families, dietary restrictions, learning styles
Real-world connections anchor learning in authentic contexts
Troubleshooting sections show understanding of actual classroom challenges
Respects Grade 1 developmental needs: comfort, safety, choice
Assessment through observation rather than testing pressure
weaknesses: Some decision points are obvious rather than genuinely challenging teacher decisions
Extension lessons (15-20) may push beyond what Grade 1s naturally need

recommendations: Consider making lessons 15-20 optional enrichment rather than core unit
Add more specific timing guidance for decision points (e.g., 'after 10 minutes of activity')
Strengthen connections between family lesson and other vocabulary themes
Provide clearer bridge activities between Lesson 13 (routine) and Lesson 14 (presentation)
Consider reducing extension lessons to focus on deeper practice of core vocabulary
Add more specific guidance for substitute teachers about Pierre puppet character voice/personality
